name: 蒲公英
evolution: 蒲公英 → 蒲公英娃娃 Lv.26
description: 喜欢阳光，可爱的圆形精灵，三只一起在草丛中随风飘动。风吹到哪就会飞到哪，总是无忧无虑的。
descriptionEn: It loves sunlight; a cute round creature that drifts with the wind through the grass three at a time. Wherever the wind blows, it flies, always free of care.

skills.name: 超级糖果
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己获得萌化：本次技能威力+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage and gains Cuteify: this skill's power +60.

skills.name: 示弱
skills.description: 自己获得萌化：速度永久+150。

skills.name: 顶端优势
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 反弹
skills.description: 将自己的萌化转移给敌方。
skills.descriptionEn: Transfers its Cuteify to the enemy.

skills.name: 倾泻
skills.description: 造成魔伤，若本次攻击未被防御技能应对，则驱散双方所有印记。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. If this attack is not countered by a defensive skill, dispels all marks on both sides.

skills.name: 叶绿光束
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 丰饶
skills.descriptionEn: Gains +140% physical attack and magic attack.

skills.name: 破罐破摔
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己有减益时，本次技能威力+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. If it has any debuff, this skill's power +60.

skills.name: 生日蛋糕
skills.description: 驱散自己的减益，自己的增益翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Dispels its own debuffs and doubles its own buffs.

skills.name: 月光合奏
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，双方携带的所有精灵每有1层萌化，本次技能连击数+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage with 1 hit. For each stack of Cuteify on every creature carried by both sides, this skill's combo count +1.

skills.name: 光能聚集
skills.description: 造成魔伤，每次使用其他草系技能后，本技能威力永久+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage. Each time another Grass-type skill is used, this skill's power permanently +60.

skills.name: 仙人掌刺击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 爆米花爆破
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 抽枝
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：自己回复50%生命和5能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage. Counters status: restores 50% HP and 5 energy to itself.
